hero.title: Tirthesh Patil
hero.subtitle: Technical Product Manager with 2+ years of experience building and scaling fintech platforms across payments, AI, and data systems at Jio Financial Services. I own high-throughput systems handling 180K+ daily transactions and AI platforms serving 65K+ daily prompts.

about.lead_html: I bridge the gap between business priorities, user needs, and technical execution so teams can move from ambiguity to launch with confidence.

cards.title: What I Do
cards.description: I lead products from opportunity discovery and requirements shaping through development, launch, and iteration, keeping business goals and delivery realities aligned.

cards.title: How I Work
cards.description: I simplify messy problem spaces, define what matters, and help cross-functional teams make decisions quickly without losing sight of customer value.

cards.title: Where I Add Value
cards.description: Especially effective in fast-moving teams that need structured product thinking, stakeholder alignment, and someone who can translate between business and engineering.

projects.title: JFS SuperApp • Little Nest
bullets: Directed high-impact product strategy — balanced regulatory constraints, engineering bandwidth, and revenue goals across payments and AI verticals → delivered a cross-functional roadmap enabling 5+ successful product launches.

Owned the UPI payments vertical — drove NPCI compliance certification, multi-bank API integration, and real-time monitoring → scaled volume to 180K average daily transactions at 99%+ uptime and 85%+ payment success rate.

Defined the Consent Management compliance vertical — authored RBI-compliant AA specifications and managed fintech vendor integrations → delivered consolidated financial tracking to 10K+ monthly active users.

Spearheaded the analytics platform implementation — defined KPI frameworks for tracking transaction volume, adoption, and drop-off rates via Google Analytics → drove a 15%+ improvement in key user engagement metrics.
Led product initiatives for the AI-powered financial marketplace — defined requirements and managed third-party lender API integrations → generated a ~20% cross-sell revenue uplift post-launch.

projects.title: Government Engagements • Asset Management System • AI Chatbot Solutions
bullets: Owned the JFS Agentic Chatbot — executed an iterative roadmap and maintained executive stakeholder alignment → scaled platform usage to 65K daily prompts within the JFS SuperApp.

Led the 0-to-1 build of the Little Nest platform — drove the full ideation-to-launch cycle alongside senior enterprise stakeholders → achieved a 75%+ reduction in manual operations with 500+ automated daily transactions.
Managed execution across a 60+ member cross-functional team — facilitated agile ceremonies and streamlined operational workflows → drove a ~50% improvement in team velocity across concurrent tracks.
Delivered a RAG-based multilingual AI chatbot — led requirement documentation reviews and coordinated rigorous QA cycles → scaled product to 10K daily active users across 12 languages.

Optimized product delivery pipelines — conducted rigorous backlog refinement and cross-track sprint planning → reduced development rework by ~20% while keeping releases tightly aligned to business goals.

projects.title: Frontend Web Development
bullets: Spearheaded frontend web development using the MERN stack — collaborated with clients to translate business requirements into technical architectures → shipped 5+ cross-browser-compatible product features with zero major post-launch defects.

projects.label: Product Case Study

details.heading: The Problem
details.text: Operations needed one reliable system for class creation, slot management, bookings, and day-to-day administration.

details.heading: What I Drove
details.text: Requirement shaping, stakeholder coordination, prioritization, launch planning, and post-release iteration.

details.heading: Outcome
details.text: A more structured operating workflow that supported adoption, issue resolution, and smoother customer-facing booking journeys.
